proposal.reason: Primary change is in **copy-engine**: CE/ltOki ring isolation, CE stream/QP queue assignment, and CE batch-launch behavior to prevent mixed CE+ltOki hangs. **enqueue** is also substantive because it adds runtime user-stream ring hinting on every enqueue path (not just mechanical wiring). **symmetric** is needed for the independent device-side fix in `okiReduceDmaCmd` (tail chunk sizing and AR pre-broadcast clamp) within symmetric collective kernel code.
